disorder-name.detail: Mild cognitive impairment; matched clinical cohort used for prediction modelling

dataset-of-origin.detail: MCI data sourced from aging/dementia cohorts: ADNI, AIBL, and DEMGEN. The paper does not explicitly separate which aging dataset provides AD vs MCI; all three aging datasets (ADNI, AIBL, DEMGEN) are cited as clinical sources. MCI has 3 scanning sites in Table 1, suggesting possibly fewer datasets contribute; dataset-specific breakdown not reported.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The clinical datasets were obtained from ... ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative), AIBL (The Australian Imaging, Biomarkers and Lifestyle Flagship Study), DEMGEN (Norwegian Dementia Genetics Network)"
